name: Pave Resin Ltd

reviews.author: Jim Hughes
reviews.text: A fantastic job by Charles and the guys. We couldn't believe how quickly it was all done, from the initial quote to completion in just under four days! … They kept us updated throughout the project with photos and regular updates…

reviews.author: Louise Preston
reviews.text: Charles and the team were professional, polite, and hardworking from start to finish. The whole job ran like clockwork… I also appreciated that no deposit was requested until the work had started… The finished drive is outstanding.

reviews.author: Rachel Hanson
reviews.text: Fantastic! Charles was very professional and gave us a great price… the street was left spotless… Can't recommend Charles and his team enough.

reviews.author: Rob Riley
reviews.text: …they helped us pick the correct surface colour and design we wanted… their workmanship is second to none.

reviews.author: John Brahms
reviews.text: They understood our needs and gave us a price immediately… The quality of work is exemplary with fantastic attention to detail.

reviews.author: Atifa Shah
reviews.text: They came on time and completed the drive in two days… Would recommend with a million stars.

reviews.author: Simon Pennington
reviews.text: Skilled operators and worked flat out… did a great job at a good price.

reviews.author: Chris Everitt
reviews.text: They did a great job repaving our garden… All done and dusted in a day.

reviews.author: Mohsin Patel
reviews.text: Amazing work carried out in my garden… Very glad I chose Pave Resin Ltd.

reviews.author: Cath OBrien
reviews.text: Very pleased with the garden make over. Martin's team are hard working, punctual and informative.
